## Census Blocks

```{r Plot Manhattan Blocks}
#| code-summary: "Leaflet Census Blocks Map - Manhattan County"
#| code-line-numbers: "|11"

# Download data using our helper function
download_data(
  url = "https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2025/TABBLOCK20/tl_2025_36_tabblock20.zip",
  relative_dir = "census/TIGER2025/TABBLOCK20")

# Read Shapefile
census_blocks  <- read_sf("./data_mid/census/TIGER2025/TABBLOCK20/tl_2025_36_tabblock20.shp")

# Filter to Manhattan County (061)
new_york_county_blocks <- census_blocks %>%
  filter(STATEFP20 == "36", COUNTYFP20 == "061") # Different field names

# Plot Leaflet Map
new_york_county_blocks %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(weight = 0.5, opacity = 1.0)
```
  
::: {.notes}
Exact same mechanics as the previous slide

One difference - field names! Why? I don't know...

8,132,968 blocks in the 50 states + D.C.
:::
